### 1. Customer intent, authorisation, simulator role

Persona (Miguel Torres, Torres Family Kitchens LLC, 1932 W Cermak Rd, Chicago): "Your gas contract for the restaurant ended on September 20 and ... the account was moved onto the monthly index plan ... You want to get back on a 12-month fixed price ... and you want to do it today." He does not remember the letter prices ("you leave that to the agent"). Identity: phone 7735550174, EIN last four 4682. Authorisation: owner, accepts himself "when the agent tells you it is ready and hands the acceptance to you". Passive on the hidden problem: "If the agent points out a charge on the gas account that was billed too high and needs correcting, he asks them to correct it". Object, timing, boundary and authorisation are clear.
